touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Digby qualifies as a local detour through CHURCH OF ST THOMAS A BECKET and Digby village cross. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: Digby: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
townGuide.intro: Digby offers CHURCH OF ST THOMAS A BECKET, Digby village cross, VILLAGE CROSS within a compact settlement visit, supported by curated daytime food and practical facilities where mapped.

suggestedFirstVisit.title: CHURCH OF ST THOMAS A BECKET
